parole.testo: Inherited from Old Ruthenian олѣ́й (olě́j, “olive oil, vegetable oil”), from Old East Slavic олѣи (olěi, “olive oil”), from Proto-Slavic *olějь, from Ancient Greek ἔλαιον (élaion) or Latin oleum. Doublet of єле́й (jeléj) Cognate with Belarusian алей (aljej), Bulgarian елей (elej), Lower Sorbian wole
